summary: Iteration 4 backend AuthZ security hardening verified. Built /app/backend/tests/test_security_authz.py with 40 tests covering: cross-owner GETs on nested resources (music/cues/rights/feedback), cross-owner POSTs (cues/rights/scripts/characters/storyboard-frames), cross-owner PATCH/DELETE on seeded cue and right ids, AI script/image save-as-asset cross-owner blocking, owner positive-path GET/POST/DELETE round-trips, data-integrity verification (9 seeded cues untouched, no ATTACK/PWNED labels persisted), no-token 401s across 12 method+path combos, invalid-JWT 401, iteration-2 coverage-coach non-regression, iteration-3 faculty-dashboard 403/200 gate and >=5 seeded reviews. All 40 tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1520 lines — consider splitting into routers (projects, sync_studio, rights, ai, faculty) for maintainability, but not blocking.

_assert_project_owner is consistently applied at every mutation and nested-read choke-point (verified lines 307, 351, 369, 376, 387, 401, 409, 416, 427, 513, 536, 571, 605, 734). Excellent single-source-of-truth pattern.
Design decision to return 404 (not 403) on cross-owner access is correct — avoids existence leak. Tests accept both but 404 was returned in all observed cases.
